g.text: Selected observations from MSD Table 7.2, 1940-2002; original coverage
Archival expenses with coverage/accounting breaks | These amounts include supplementary assistance attributed to benefit
categories and are not spliced into Treasury's modern expenses. March years before 1990; cash through 1994 and accrual
thereafter. Missing cells are not zero.
Sources: MSD Statistical Report 2002, Table 7.2: selected core-benefit/pension expenses 1940-2002, including supplementary assistance
